title: MM6 male peasant 4
regions: native green cloth/leather panels and colored weapon/shield details; protect dark skin, pale feather/bone trim and blade, warm necklace and brown inner shield straps
description: The same adult male warrior with dark warm-brown skin, bald head, strong muscular human build. Bare torso with a broad pale grey feather/bone shoulder mantle whose layered feathers extend down his BACK to the waist and dangling small pale beads over the upper chest, warm ochre-gold neck band. Thin olive-green upper-arm bands. Olive-GREEN front/back loincloth panels hanging toward the knees with pale grey feather/bone trim around the hips; wrapped feather/bone lower-leg guards with olive-green straps above bare feet. His RIGHT hand holds a slender brown wooden spear approximately his full standing height in shaft length, with several olive-green binding wraps with a narrow pointed silver blade and dark hanging cord tassels. His LEFT arm carries a small dark rounded/oval buckler shield about half his torso height with an olive-green outer face and brown inner leather straps. Preserve native proportions, all gear, handedness and silhouette from each view; no additional helmet, body armor, cloth cape or boots.
mask_calibration_note: Side-view loincloth folds are greener than NATF olive armor. Extend this family hue range through green while retaining strong saturation seeds and neutral-blade protection; keep the skin, feathers and wooden shaft outside coverage.
